findings: Every meaningful documentation-only PR must include a schema-valid cumulative lifecycle record.
A successful contract or static-analysis job does not replace full CI or source-backed scientific evidence.
The Park MVP must remain bounded to a validated ZTF DR24 workflow; multi-survey and multi-modality expansion is a later platform track.
CPVS membership remains a separate unresolved research issue and must not be represented as resolved by product architecture work.
CIN remains an optional, independent, human-feedback subsystem and is not part of the MVP.
